create_policy_agent: create a Policy agent with a network handler, player count, and sampling temperature
reset_policy_state: reset the Policy agent observation transform state and network handler state
compute_policy_actions: compute actions for player slots using observations and legal actions via the Policy agent
configure_all_policies: configure the Policy agent to calculate policies for all players regardless of slot list
inspect_policy_string: inspect the Policy agent string representation showing its sampling temperature configuration
